title: Neolttwigi
tagline: Press as you land, release as she lands.
description: A rhythm duet built on the Korean seesaw jumping game. Two girls in hanbok stand on the ends of a board across a straw bale: press as your feet land, hold while your partner flies, release as she lands, and send each other higher over five courses. Play with a computer partner, take turns with a friend on one screen, learn with hints, or watch the game play. In-app Rules book, portrait and landscape play, synthesised sound.
howToPlay: Pick a course, then try Learn it first: slower, forgiving, with a hint button.
A ring closes on the next landing. Press as the girl's feet touch the board.
Keep your finger down while your partner flies: you are crouching.
Release the moment she lands to spring up. Perfect timing sends you higher.
Harmony fills with clean contacts; a miss costs it, and an empty bar slips the board.
Two Players: the left half of the screen is the left girl, the right half the right girl.
Watch and Learn plays both girls and thinks before each phrase. Pause it any time.
